title: Elbow Jumper Reps
description: A mid-range staple: shooters catch and shoot repeatedly from both elbows, the spot most guarded mid-range looks still come from.

content.objective: Build a reliable mid-range catch-and-shoot from both elbows.
content.setup: A passer feeds the shooter alternately at the left and right elbow.
instructions: Catch at the elbow already squared toward the basket.
Shoot immediately off the catch, no dribble.
Make ten total, alternating elbows after every make.
Switch roles with the passer after the set is complete.
coachingPoints: Square the feet to the rim before the catch, not after.
Keep the same release point from both elbows.
Follow through and hold the finish on every rep.
commonMistakes: Catching off-balance and fixing it after the fact instead of before.
Rushing the shot to keep pace with the passer.
Letting the elbow drift out to the side instead of staying under the ball.
content.safety: Passer stays out of the shooter's direct line to the basket.
